Our Heritage

Scotland's Finest
Since 1997

West Coast Fish has been supplying premium Atlantic Scottish Salmon for over 25 years. From whole fillets to specialty cuts, every product is handled with the care and expertise that comes from decades at the forefront of the Scottish seafood industry.

We work directly with Scottish salmon farms and processors to deliver the freshest, highest-quality product to our customers worldwide.
